turns.patient_opening: I’m 43, and I came in because I have severe pain in my lower chest and upper chest—like a knife-stroke, violent, sickening pain that feels like it goes to my thoracic spine and also to my left scapula. It started very fast, about 7/10 for how quickly it began, and the pain is 10/10, with the center of it around 5/10. I also feel nauseous and I’ve been vomiting repeatedly.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have high cholesterol, or are you taking any medications to treat high cholesterol?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t know of any high cholesterol, and I’m not taking any medications for high cholesterol. My medical history is not clear to me.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have a burning sensation that starts in your stomach and moves up into your throat, and does it sometimes come with a bitter taste in your mouth? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: No. I don’t have a burning sensation that goes from my stomach up into my throat, and I don’t notice a bitter taste in my mouth.
